headline: Time Technoplast Limited: Inter-se Transfer of Shares Between Promoters
sum: Time Technoplast disclosed an inter-se transfer of shares between promoters to the NSE under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011.
detail: Time Technoplast Limited filed a disclosure with NSE on 15 June 2026 regarding an inter-se transfer of shares between promoters, complying with Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure indicates a reorganisation of promoter shareholding without triggering a public acquisition obligation. The specific quantum of shares transferred and the identities of the transferor and transferee promoters are contained in the full disclosure filed with the Exchange.
